author: .christn
content:
That's the ingress default cert — you get it when the TLS handshake has no Server Name Indication SNI, i.e. openssl s_client without -servername. 

Try:
openssl s_client -connect relay-plataberget.ultrasound.money:443 -servername relay-plataberget.ultrasound.money

or just curl -v https://relay-plataberget.ultrasound.money/eth/v1/builder/status 
Prysm's client probably sends SNI, so it should work as is.
Lmk if the problem persists.

(This is the same as on our production domains).
